How to play

    

    
Goal: be the last survivor of 50. Jump from the plane, find guns (glowing beams), stay inside the shrinking blue zone, and use vehicles to cross the island.

    
About: Island Reign is an original game with bot opponents (offline, single player). The 3D engine (Three.js) is bundled in this file, so it needs no internet connection.
